pages.title: Mineral Veins
pages.text: Mineral Veins are special blocks that can be continuously mined by rigs, producing infinite ore. Each vein type corresponds to a specific ore.$(br2)Veins generate naturally in the world with different rules per type.

pages.title: Vein Types
pages.text: Exclusive Endfield Industry veins:$(br)$(li)Originium Vein — Overworld$(li)Amethyst Vein — Overworld$(li)Ferrium Vein — Overworld$(li)Cuprium Vein — Overworld$(br2)Vanilla ores (Coal, Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Emerald, Lapis, Redstone) also have corresponding vein blocks.

pages.title: Mining Methods
pages.text: Veins are mined using rigs. Place a rig above the vein to start automatic collection.$(br2)Different rig tiers can mine different veins:$(br)$(li)$(l:arknights_endfield:resourcing/portable_rig)Portable Originium Rig$() — basic veins$(li)$(l:arknights_endfield:resourcing/electric_rig)Electric Mining Rig$() — intermediate veins$(li)$(l:arknights_endfield:resourcing/electric_rig_mk2)Electric Mining Rig Mk-II$() — advanced veins
